row.team_price_text: Premium: $26.10/mo billed annually at 15K emails/mo ($29 monthly); volume-priced, not per user
row.evidence: Mailjet's SAML article says SAML SSO is available from the 100,000 Premium Plan and Custom accounts and that users must first be activated in Mailjet and then added in the IdP; the help centre has no SCIM articles and the pricing page lists no provisioning feature.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none). Plan line-up changed since June: Free, Starter $9, Essential $19, Premium $29 per month at 15K emails (annual billing 10% off: Starter $8.10, Essential $17.10, Premium $26.10), Custom on quote. Multi-user access is only ticked for Premium and Custom, so the team plan moves from Essential to Premium. SSO plan price fell from June's ~$280/mo: Premium at 100K emails is $100.80/mo annual ($112 monthly). SSO covers shared-access users only; users are created in Mailjet first (no JIT or SCIM documented). Okta's OIN 'Mailjet' app is SWA only. API has own-user settings endpoints only, no team-member management.

plans.name: Premium
plans.price_text: $26.10/month billed annually or $29 monthly (15,000 emails/mo); $100.80 annual / $112 monthly at 100,000 emails
plans.notes: SAML SSO only from the 100,000-email Premium tier.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented; help-centre search for 'scim' returns 0 articles. Recorded as none by absence.

limitations.text: User endpoints only read and update the authenticated user's own settings.

user_api.notes: The API's /v3/REST/user and /myprofile resources cover the authenticated user's own settings; /apikey manages sub-account API keys. No endpoints for inviting or removing team members are documented.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SWA as checked (read from page markup); Mailjet's SAML guide builds a custom Okta SAML app.

entra.notes: Custom non-gallery SAML app; learn.microsoft.com mailjet-tutorial returns 404.

fallbacks.notes: SAML guide says users are activated in Mailjet first and then assigned in the IdP; JIT is not mentioned.
